fields.description:
**Context**
Emily's desktop walkthrough flagged that the in-progress sign-up header buries useful fields and surfaces less-useful ones. The team went back and forth on a couple of layout options before landing on a final decision.

**Requirements**

* Move Proof Status and Completion fields to the far right of the header.
* Add Partner to the header, displayed as the short code (not the full partner name), e.g. "GDC" not the full name.
* Do NOT add a generic "Source" field to the header — decided against, in favor of just Partner.
* Add a new "Deal Information" section to the sign-up detail/edit screen (not the header) showing Deal Name, visible to reps — this repurposes the section reps currently see as "System Information."
* Should be easy to remove later via a page layout edit if the team decides it's not needed (no special build required for that; just a quick layout change).

**Constraints / Dependencies**
Hovering over the Deal on the table view already exposes the full partner name (e.g. Cypher, GDC) — team confirmed this is fine to keep as-is (reps already have this info; don't want to introduce a new limitation mid-project).

**Potential approaches discussed**
Team considered replacing the individual operator/partner/market/country/state/vertical header fields with a single concatenated "Deal Name" field (plus icon) to solve mobile stacking issues, but this was not finalized for the header — that concatenated approach was instead used for the table view columns (see separate ticket). For the header, the decision was Partner short code, not full Deal Name.

**Source**
Fathom — WagerTech <> Jumpr Weekly Sync, 09/23/2026 (https://fathom.video/calls/831090060) — Emily Vandenberg \~20:32–24:53, Lina Ceniccola \~46:17–50:19, Kobi Kunasekaran \~49:02–50:47. Also Taryn's notes, Sign-ups > "proof & completion fields move to left of header," "Add Source field to header & add partner short code."
